Thanks — quick update. I pulled the latest inventory and curated the fields Samir asked for. Key notes:
- Attached: third_party_inventory.csv (complete with columns Samir listed).
- The payments edge-proxy (EdgeFlow Ltd) replicates logs to an APAC analytics cluster that sits in Singapore; that cluster receives anonymized traces, but transaction metadata (non-PII routing ids) are persisted for 30 days for debugging. EU customers' traces are pseudonymized before crossing to APAC.
- Transfer mechanisms: we have SCCs in place with EdgeFlow and with OptiLogs (observability). For one older vendor (TransitCache Inc) we rely on the DPA clause with an approved derogation documented in 2026; we'll flag that for Legal.
- KMS: primary model weights and customer KV caches are Redwood-managed KMS; we do offer a dedicated HSM option for Dedicated/Private customers but FinBridge is on hosted plan so default is Redwood-managed.
- Planned work: EdgeFlow is scheduled for a migration that could change replication topology in mid-April; mitigation is a canary replication step and we will gate any wider change until Legal signs off the transfer appendices.

I've uploaded: third_party_inventory.csv and dataflow_diagram_v2.png to the Drive link and added an excerpt (DPA_excerpt.pdf) for TransitCache showing the derogation language. Please review. If it looks good I'll send these to Samir and loop Legal.

If possible, could you provide answers and any supporting docs by EOD Monday PST? We'll keep the DPA path but need these clarifications to progress.
